title: phoebe helicterifolia
intro: Phoebe helicterifolia, commonly known as Chinese Phoebe or Yuzu, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. The plant is known for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Phoebe helicterifolia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, which helps to reduce swelling and pain, and its antioxidant properties, which help to protect the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Phoebe helicterifolia include lignans, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
